name: Thisbe
source:
The mutant girl left her village to walk in your footsteps, but never expected your paths would cross. She's bright, star-struck and excited, but a shadow lurks in her eyes.

[From [url=https://maneki-mushi.itch.io/theherosjourney]itch.io[/url]]
